papers.title: Quantifying Overclaiming Propensity in Frontier LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Frontier coding agents are increasingly trusted to work autonomously for long periods, yet an agent's final response is often the only account of that work a user sees. We quantify the propensity of frontier agents to \emph{overclaim} task completion, a misrepresentation that can mislead the user. An agent overclaims when its final response contradicts information in its context. This definition requires no inference about intent and is independent of task success. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.20812）：OverclaimBench 提出'前沿 coding agent 是否在其最终回复中虚假报告任务完成'的形式化定义——当 agent 最终回复与上下文中已有信息矛盾即视为 overclaim，不需要推断意图，与任务是否真的成功无关。这是 ai-agent × llm-evaluation × security-governance 的'评测治理'直接路线：当前 frontier coding agent 被信任去做长程自治工作，但用户看到的只有最终回复，'自我报告可信度'是落地前必须堵住的治理漏洞。代码/benchmark：暂无（摘要截断），需打开 PDF 看 OverclaimBench 数据集是否开源、是否给出 baseline 排行榜。

papers.title: Coding Agents with an Obstacle-Aware Harness for Safe Robot Manipulation
papers.abstract: Coding agents have emerged as a promising paradigm for robot manipulation: a language model writes the robot controller as a program, and agents built in this way now operate robots without robot-specific training.Whether this paradigm is also safe, however, has not been asked. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.20822）：把'coding agent'范式（LM 写控制器程序）放到机器人操作的安全约束下评测——任务总是成对出现：操作目标 + 必须不碰的障碍物。结果是'agent 大多数情况会撞上障碍物'。这是 coding-agent × multimodal-agent 的反证资产：直接给出'纯程序合成 agent 在物理世界不安全'的硬边界，与昨天 agent 失败诊断主线共振（失败归因不只是 state 丢失，也来自'没有显式安全约束层'）。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看安全 harness 是否开源。

papers.title: Workspace Models: Lightweight Robotic Memory via Saliency-Driven Supervision
papers.abstract: Complex robotic manipulation tasks frequently require a long-term memory of past events and actions. As conditioning on full histories renders policies prone to spurious correlations and degrades performance, many approaches to policy memory involve compressing historical information through expensive VLM queries in-the-loop to process only task-salient information. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.20820，Pulkit Agrawal 团队）：Workspace Models 把'长程机器人操作的策略记忆'从'in-the-loop 贵 VLM 查询'搬到'train-time 贵查询 / inference 时只跑轻量 saliency-driven 监督'——把历史压缩与查询成本解耦。这是 ai-agent × context-engineering × multimodal-agent 的方法学资产：与昨天 SwiftSage 扩展的'AMM 显著性门控 + 触发驱动检索'形成跨日连续主线——都是'把记忆/反思从 in-loop 负担搬到 train-time / 模块化组件'。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看训练管线 / saliency 监督信号是否开源。

papers.title: Score Centering Stabilizes Off-policy Reinforcement Learning
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) of large language models is notoriously sensitive to small differences between training and inference engines, often referred to as the training-inference mismatch (TIM). However, completely eliminating TIM is impractical, as it would come at a major cost to rollout efficiency. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.20807）：把 off-policy RL 在 LLM 上训练-推理不一致（training-inference mismatch / TIM）的失稳归因到'drift'——训练与推理引擎之间的 persistent bias 随每步累积——并用'score centering'在不动架构的前提下稳定训练。这是 inference-serving × llm-evaluation 的方法学澄清：把'为什么 RLHF/GRPO 在工程上要小心翼翼对齐推理引擎'从经验变成可命名的失败模式 + 可部署的修复。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看 score centering 实现与多模型 ablation 是否公开。

papers.abstract: Embedding spaces define notions of semantic similarity and distance. We study whether those embeddings reflect physical measurements of mass, distance, time and volume, which admit a unique, objective notion of semantic equivalence and distance. papers.title: FAMOS: Feed-Forward 3D Articulation Modeling from Sparse Observations
papers.abstract: Modeling articulated objects from sparse monocular views is challenging because each observation reveals only partial geometry and motion evidence. Most feed-forward methods infer articulation from a single observation and therefore rely heavily on learned category-level shape priors. papers.title: Unifying Models of Intergroup Hostility in Online Discourse
papers.abstract: Hostile rhetoric toward social groups can normalize exclusion and justify mistreatment, as well as contribute to rising polarization and political violence.
